description: This file is a Java class implementing the CarDao interface. It provides data access methods for Car entities, interacting with the database via the CarRepository. The class includes methods to find, add, remove, and update cars, as well as retrieve all cars.

classes.name: CarDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CarDao interface, providing CRUD operations for Car entities.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Car entity by its ID using the CarRepository.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a Car entity by its ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new Car entity to the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Car entity identified by its ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Car entities as a list of maps.
